name: nocapmocap
description: Describe a movement and get a 3D animation for a Roblox R15 or Humanoid character. Preview the versions and choose a download.

interface.longDescription: Tell ChatGPT the movement you want. NoCapMocap checks with you before it makes anything. Watch each version and compare them side by side. For Roblox, download the Studio text file and paste it into RBXMonkey. You can also import any version from Motion Lab History. For Humanoid, choose a standard or Mixamo FBX file.
defaultPrompt: Create a confident victory dance for my Roblox character.
Create a Humanoid animation of a person who looks behind them, then walks forward.

publication.release_notes: First release. Describe a movement, and NoCapMocap makes a 3D animation for a Roblox R15 or Humanoid character. You agree before it starts. Then you preview and compare the versions in the chat.

es-ES.subtitle: Animaciones con tus palabras
es-ES.description: Dile a ChatGPT el movimiento que quieres. NoCapMocap te consulta antes de crear nada. Mira cada versión y compáralas lado a lado. Para Roblox, descarga el archivo de texto de Studio y pégalo en RBXMonkey. También puedes importar cualquier versión desde el historial de Motion Lab. Para Humanoid, elige un archivo FBX estándar o de Mixamo.

positive.description: Make a Roblox animation from a described movement. The credit cost shows before anything starts.
positive.prompt: Create a confident victory dance for my Roblox character.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls quote_animation and shows the movement, Roblox R15, the length, the number of versions and the credit cost. It waits for the user to agree. After the user agrees, it calls generate_animation and then open_animation_preview. The preview shows each version when it is ready and offers the Roblox Studio text file to paste into RBXMonkey.

positive.description: Make a Humanoid animation and download an FBX file.
positive.prompt: Make an in-place running animation for a Humanoid character.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT quotes a Humanoid running animation and waits for the user to agree. After the user agrees, it starts the generation and opens the preview. For each version, the user can download a standard FBX or a Mixamo FBX file.

positive.description: Check the credits on the connected account.
positive.prompt: How many NoCapMocap credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls get_account and tells the user how many credits they have and how much of this connection's credit allowance is left. It does not offer to sell credits.

positive.description: Explain what the app can make.
positive.prompt: What kinds of animations can NoCapMocap make, and for which characters?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls get_capabilities. It explains that the app makes body animations from a described movement for Roblox R15 and Humanoid characters, and it gives the supported lengths.

positive.description: Ask for a rig that the app does not support.
positive.prompt: Make a waving animation for my Roblox R6 character.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says that R6 is not supported for now and offers R15. If the user agrees, it quotes an R15 waving animation and waits for the user to agree before it starts.

negative.description: A request for a 2D picture is not an animation request.
negative.prompt: Draw a picture of a cat in a party hat.

negative.description: Help with game code does not need the app.
negative.prompt: Write a Roblox Lua script that makes my character double jump.

negative.description: General Roblox questions do not need the app.
negative.prompt: Which Roblox games are popular right now?
